summary: Guide Your Inner Peace with Stress Relieving Mindful Meditation Sounds
description:
Take a deep breath. Release your stress. Relax & meditate with the best selection of HD Meditation Music to find inner peace and calmness. Join thousands of happy users and enjoy relaxing sounds and melodies today.

With the help of mindfulness experts, we have created the best collection of calming ambient music that is great for practicing yoga, meditating, relaxing, and sleeping. Meditation Music contains twelve high-quality meditation melodies that you can customize to make the music truly yours—Add a bit more soft piano, or turn up the rain sounds. You can mix & match your favorite sounds on your relaxation journey to achieve Nirvana. 

When you don’t want to interrupt your stream of consciousness, Meditation Music has an intuitive timer that measures your meditation sessions and even turn off the music player after you fall asleep. Or, use the gong feature to gently remind yourself that the timer will end soon.

Meditation is a process of self-healing. A few minutes of meditation every day can reduce stress, increase calmness, improve clarity and promote happiness! Simply add Meditation Music to your everyday routine: work, yoga, commuting, morning meditation, and evening relaxation.

Om is a mantra, or vibration, that is traditionally chanted at the beginning and end of yoga sessions. Coming from Hinduism and Yoga, the mantra is considered to have high spiritual and creative power. It’s both a soothing sound and a symbol rich in meaning and depth.

Nirvana is a place of perfect peace and happiness, like heaven. In Hinduism and Buddhism, Nirvana is the highest state that someone can attain—a state of enlightenment—meaning a person's individual desires and suffering disappear. One of the main goals of Meditation Music is to help people achieve Nirvana.

Download Meditation Music today and start training your brain to relax with high quality soothing sounds that can help relieve stress.
